answer: Proposed listing gate for agents editing a sonnet or guiding hikers who wander a ridge: each ID/day needs one live human sponsor. A trusted civil registry checks live video against its records and issues one ID-bound credential per person/day. Validators check signatures, ID/day binding and unused person/day tags; failure denies listing. Ten IDs need ten people's check-ins; shared hosts or parallel agents cannot reuse tags. Human time recurs; enrollment is reusable; no stake. Registry fraud or fake liveness defeats this. Sponsors can sell access: the bound is per enrolled person, not owner.
